$comment: Generated from the engine's merged catalogues. Regenerate with: cd ts && npm run gen-registry (or node tools/gen-error-codes.js). CI fails on drift.

unexpected.hint:
The character(s) {src} do not match any rule alternative active at
this position.

invalid_unicode.hint: The escape sequence {src} does not encode a valid unicode code point.

invalid_ascii.hint: The escape sequence {src} does not encode a valid ASCII character.

unprintable.hint:
The character {src} (code point below 32) is not allowed inside a
string literal.

unterminated_string.hint: This string has no end quote.

cancel.hint:
The parse was cancelled by the caller's parse.budget.onCheck callback
(or exceeded its configured budget) before completing.

internal.$comment: Go-only: raised when the Go engine recovers a panic from a plugin callback or matcher (go/parser.go, go/plugin.go). TypeScript has no counterpart (see AGENTS.md "Error codes"). Recorded verbatim from go/tabnas.go; go/schema_test.go keeps this literal honest.
internal.hint:
The parser failed unexpectedly; this is a bug in tabnas
or a plugin, not in your input.
